JD Vance on Russia diesel deal:
We saw an opportunity to lower diesel prices. One of the criticisms that you often hear about desanctioning Russia is that somehow it's going to—well, now the Russians are going to be able to sell their diesel fuel.
Well, that is an absurd argument in my view because, Raymond, they've always been able to sell their diesel fuel. They're just selling it at a massive discount to the People's Republic of China.
Meanwhile, our farmers and our consumers have suffered. Trump looked at that and said, "Why are we subsidizing foreign countries? We should make it easier for our own farmers to afford a good life." 
And that's exactly what we're doing.

Google illegally cut down an estimated 250,000 trees in northern Finland to build a data center, sparking national outrage. 
The company cleared 330 hectares of forest near the town of Muhos without first completing the required environmental impact assessments. 
Conservationists estimate another 150,000 trees were felled at a second site in Otanmäki. 
Finland’s licensing authority ordered Google to stop work at both sites earlier this month. 
The sites are part of a €13 billion AI infrastructure project, the largest of its kind in Finland.
